topic: Flight-identified and wind-tunnel aerodynamic data of RC-class airframes, and method references used for the Stik lateral-directional work
note: Local copies live in the gitignored references/rc-aero-data/. Guide: docs/research/flight-dynamics/rc-aero-data-sources.md. Other airframes are comparisons, not Stik acceptance data.

files.use: Ultra Stick 25e (1.959 kg, b 1.27 m): flight-identified lateral matrices (sec. 3.5.2, eq. 3.26), bifilar inertias (table 3.1), modes (table 3.5), US Mini tunnel baseline. Used by D10-R2 (Cnb 0.046/rad, CYb -0.35/rad, Clb -0.039/rad, Cnr -0.17/rad).

files.use: FASER (Ultra Stick 120) NASA LaRC 12-ft tunnel lift and drag (q 2 psf, alpha -5..40 deg) against VLM and Digital DATCOM. Longitudinal only; linear-region fit CL0 0.1134, CLalpha 0.0762/deg (table 4.3).

files.license: NASA Technical Reports Server, public distribution; AIAA conference paper. Reference only, do not redistribute.
files.use: FASER = Hangar 9 Ultra Stick 120: geometry (table 1), trifilar mass properties (table 2), tunnel summary (stalls at 12 and 15 deg, laterally stable to 30 deg, slightly directionally unstable 17-20 deg).

files.license: NASA Technical Reports Server, public distribution; AIAA conference paper. Reference only, do not redistribute.
files.use: FASER forced-oscillation roll and yaw damping vs alpha, rate and reduced frequency; DATCOM agrees pre-stall. Dutch roll 0.53 Hz (k 0.255) from the linearized FASER model; UMN Ultra Stick 25 flight p-hat mostly <= 0.1, up to 0.22. Values in figures only.

files.license: NASA Technical Reports Server, public distribution; AIAA conference paper. Reference only, do not redistribute.
files.use: FASER rotary balance (20-ft spin tunnel). Flight spin (table 2): full up elevator + full rudder -> steep spin, p > 200 deg/s (gyro saturated), r ~160 deg/s, alpha 30 deg, beta 5 deg, V 100 ft/s, Omega 250 deg/s (video estimate). Steady-spin prediction did not find it.

files.use: UMN Baldr (modified Ultra Stick 120, split elevators/rudders) flight report: trim 23 m/s, pitch 5 deg, throttle 65 %. Fault-tolerant control experiment; no identified data.

files.use: 1.28 kg, b 0.97 m rudderless UAV, frequency-domain identification: Dutch roll zeta 0.12, wn 4.8 rad/s (model 0.06, 7 rad/s); roll tau 0.078 s; spiral not excited.

files.use: Full-envelope component model behind FS One: segmented fuselage side lift over +/-180 deg (sec. III.C, fig. 14), ShowTime 50 knife-edge (sec. IV.C). Used by D10-R2 sec. 7.

files.use: J. Aircraft 51(6), doi 10.2514/1.C032370. Table 1: Edge 540, Extra 260 EFL, ShowTime 50 (b 1.45 m, S 46.58 dm2, 2.90 kg, about the Stik's wing area), Ultimate TOC. ShowTime 50 knife-edge on held right rudder until the fuselage stalls near beta -65 deg; side-force generators climb.

files.use: Vector-P pusher UAV (31.5 kg, Ixx 3.14, Iyy 8.25, Izz 10.40 kg m2) lateral identification: Clb -0.0285, Cnb 0.090; CYb printed +0.029 (sign unexplained). Not an RC sport class.

files.license: Copyright the authors / AIAA; author-hosted free download. Reference only, do not redistribute.
files.use: UIUC Aero Testbed = Hangar 9 35 % Extra 260 (17.01 kg, b 2.667 m, S 1.312 m2, Ixx 1.53, Iyy 4.86, Izz 6.06 kg m2; table 1). Over 20 IMU-recorded flight spins. Baseline T0R1E1A0 (power off, full rudder, full up, neutral ailerons, low rates): pitch -55..-57 deg, sink 15.5-16.8 m/s, p 235-238 deg/s, r 150-155 deg/s, Omega b/2V 0.20. Pro-spin ailerons: nose 5 deg lower, sink +66 %, p +50 %, spin parameter halved.

files.license: NASA Technical Memorandum (SAE 1975 paper, NASA and Piper authors). Reference only.
files.use: NASA/Piper radio-controlled model stall/spin technique: model construction, inertia measurement, thrust scaling; RC scale-model spins and recoveries correlated with the full-scale airplane. Notes that a dynamically scaled model has much less tail volume than a conventional RC model and reacts very differently to controls.

files.license: NASA Contractor Report (Grumman). Reference only.
files.use: Correlation of analytical spin prediction (static, forced-oscillation and rotary-balance data of an exact replica) with flight spins of an unpowered 1/10-scale RC fighter model. Method reference for spin simulation against RC flight; not our fleet.

files.license: NASA Technical Paper (US Government work).
files.use: Spin tunnel, low-wing GA model A, nine tails. Spin-mode classes by angle of attack: steep 20-30, moderately steep 30-45, moderately flat 45-65, flat 65-90 deg. Tail configuration decides flat versus steeper modes and recovery.

files.license: NASA Technical Paper (US Government work).
files.use: Langley staff: wing leading-edge droop modifications on a light GA airplane, combining wind-tunnel, radio-controlled model and full-scale flight tests of stall/spin behaviour. Not yet read in detail.

files.license: NASA Contractor Report. Reference only.
files.use: 1/6-scale RC Piper PA-38 Tomahawk (3.5 kg, all-moving tail): more than 50 ultra-deep-stall descents and spin recoveries; full-scale-equivalent power-off deep-stall sink about 13.4 m/s at 685.8 kg.

files.license: NASA Technical Report (US Government work); supersedes NACA TN 4176.
files.use: Crossflow forces of noncircular 2-D cylinders vs flow incidence and Reynolds number, applied to directional stability and spinning. Fig. 11, subcritical square cylinders face-on: Cd about 2.0 (sharp, r/b 0-0.021), 1.6 (r/b 0.08), 1.2 (r/b 0.245); about 1.5 for all radii beyond 30 deg incidence (read from the figure). Side force can be large and change sign with Reynolds number.

files.license: NASA Technical Report (US Government work).
files.use: Polhamus, Geller, Grunwald: pressure and force characteristics of noncircular cylinders vs Reynolds number, with a potential-flow method for arbitrary shapes. Companion of TR R-29.

files.license: NASA Contractor Report. Reference only.
files.use: Polhamus review of Reynolds-number effects on bodies at high angles of attack, including noncircular cylinders and flow incidence.

files.license: Aeronautical Journal 128 (2024) 655-684, doi 10.1017/aer.2023.61, open access (Cambridge). Reference only.
files.use: Southampton FliTePlat (5.5 kg twin, b 1.96 m, S 0.488 m2, stall 11 m/s, cruise 20 m/s). Table 2: wind tunnel CD0 0.0503, K 0.0764, CL0 0.257, CLalpha 0.1122/deg; automated glides CD0 0.0552, slow-down 0.0526; manual glides off by about 70 %. Stationary propellers add 0.01-0.03 to CD depending on blade orientation.

files.license: Copyright the authors / AIAA; author-hosted free download. Reference only, do not redistribute.
files.use: UIUC GA-USTAR 1/5-scale RC Cessna 182: the NACA 2412 loses Clmax at the model's stall Re 230,000 against 2.7e6 full scale (Clmax 1.75 XFOIL, 1.62 measured at 3.1e6); the VAS1715 airfoil was designed and tunnel-verified to match full-scale Clalpha and Clmax.

files.license: Periodica Polytechnica Transportation Engineering 54(1) 88-104, CC BY.
files.use: 2.43 m, 7.5 kg twin-engine EPO mapping UAV: CFD-derived 6-DOF model against three flight tests (phugoid, short period, lateral modes). Low relevance.

files.license: NASA Technical Reports Server, public distribution; AIAA conference paper. Reference only, do not redistribute.
files.use: Morelli, Efficient Global Aerodynamic Modeling from Flight Data. NASA AirSTAR T-2: 5.5 % dynamically scaled twin-turbine jet transport, b 2.088 m, S 0.548 m2, c 0.279 m, 23.1 kg, Ix 1.60, Iy 6.13, Iz 7.49, Ixz 0.29 kg m2 (table 3). Global lateral model from flight (table 6, /rad): CYbeta -0.548 (CYbeta-alpha -4.04), Clbeta -0.130 (Clbeta-alpha -0.271), Cnbeta 0.167 (Cnbeta-alpha +0.342), Clp -0.317, Clr 0.285, Cnr -0.889, Cnp -0.447 plus alpha and control cross terms. Closest jet reference for the Avanti, not a sport jet.

files.license: NASA Technical Reports Server, public distribution; AIAA conference paper. Reference only, do not redistribute.
files.use: Morelli, Flight Test Maneuvers for Efficient Aerodynamic Modeling: orthogonal optimized multi-sine inputs on the T-2, real-time frequency-domain equation error. Method reference for flight-test excitation.

files.use: Vertical-tail yaw moment and DATCOM sidewash factor; confirms z_w positive down. Used by D10-R2.

files.use: Nicolosi, Ciliberti, Della Vecchia: vertical-tail design review; high-wing sidewash and DATCOM accuracy. Used by D10-R2.

files.use: N. J. van Wonderen: propeller slipstream effects on directional stability with a potential-flow model; DATCOM vertical-tail accuracy context. Used by D10-R2.

files.use: Chambers et al.: lateral-directional stability of a twin-jet fighter at high alpha (Cnb,dyn, LCDP departure parameters). Method reference for spin/departure criteria; not RC data.

links.note: See files; WebFetch returned 429, curl worked.
Open access (MDPI Aerospace 10(4):350, lateral-directional identification from wind-tunnel free flight); the PDF endpoint returned 403 to curl.
Thomas, Richardson, Cooke 2012: Piper Cub J-3 RPV stability and control derivatives; repository record only.
UPC thesis: longitudinal control for the Ultra Stick 25e; reuses UMN models.
C. Olson: Ultra Stick 120 spin flights 14/15 (aft CG); qualitative, no numbers.
UMN Baldr Flight 17 record (Ultra Stick 120 spin-susceptibility program); flights 12 and 13: items fd5d804c-7b02-4848-ba10-bf60da0b429b, 02931c48-beec-482b-9fd9-7e93ba07bb29.
UIUC thesis: unsteady aerodynamics of a subscale aerobatic aircraft at high angle of attack.
UIUC aircraft model specifications used by FlightGear (LaRCsim UIUC models).
Bihrle CR: rotary-balance data of a high-wing single-engine GA model (model B), alpha 8-90 deg, Omega b/2V 0-0.9; data without analysis. Low-wing companions: 19790021974, 19790022978.
NASA TP spin-tunnel part 2: low-wing model A, further tail/fuselage parametric studies.
UWE: spin dynamics of a single-engine low-wing aeroplane (full scale).
Stanford thesis: automatic spin detection and recovery for small aircraft.

Aerofly FS 2 (commercial simulator) fuselage element: 2-16 stations, round or rectangular sections, starting values Cdy 1.0-1.5 (sideways drag), Cly 0.6 (side lift; higher needs less knife-edge sideslip), Cdz 1.2, Clz 0.5, Cm 0 or slightly positive. Tuning guidance, not measured data.
Model Airplane News 2018-08: side-force generators on a large Ultra Stick give much slower knife-edge flight. Qualitative.

Gryte et al. 2018 (ICUAS): Skywalker X8 flying-wing 6-DOF model, design tools versus wind tunnel; accepted version open. A 2025 CEAS Aeronautical Journal flight identification (Low-Hansen et al.) is cited elsewhere as open access; not checked.
Ostler 2006 BYU thesis: drag polars of small electric UAVs from flight data with tunnel-measured propeller efficiency; search summary quotes CD0 0.021 for one aircraft (not verified, PDF blocked).
Cal State Sacramento thesis: flight-test methodology on a model aircraft; reports a measured stall speed.
Padayachee 2016 Wits thesis: aerodynamic identification of a low-cost UAV; pitch damping derivatives not identifiable.
Grass-runway rolling friction (cites Stinton): about 0.05 short grass, 0.08 long grass, 0.13 long wet grass; full-scale wheels, a rough bound for RC grass takeoffs.
Raymer eq. 16.50 fuselage Cnb as implemented in FAST-GA. Used by D10-R2.
